name: Joel Gott Cabernet
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: California Cabernet Sauvignon from Joel Gott, rated 90 by Wine Enthusiast. A crowd-pleasing value Cab.

🍷 STYLE: Medium to full-bodied Cabernet | Blackberry, cherry, vanilla & cocoa | Smooth, approachable tannins | Juicy finish

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Burgers and steak, Surf & Turf, meatballs, Pappardelle Bolognese, pizza.
